release_notes: Bugfix release porting the portable half of the tester's addendum II (the rest of that report targeted his own forked theme system, which has never been in this repository). Production builds are minified again (esbuild): the JS bundle drops from 5.26 MB to 3.16 MB (891 kB gzipped) with identical behaviour — a debugging convenience had been shipping to every install. campaign_report gains isp and asn group-by (NULLIF'd so unresolved lookups bucket as Unknown) and the Group By picker gains seven dimensions — Campaign/AdSet/Ad Name, UTM Placement, Source, ISP, ASN — with the picker, label map and i18n keys now derived from a single REPORT_DIMENSIONS registry instead of four silently-agreeing lists; labels shipped in all 7 locales. The login screen follows the theme system across all 12 modes instead of hardcoding gray/indigo/white, and :root gains the missing warning/danger border tokens. Dark themes no longer flash the light default on cold load: index.html applies the saved theme before first paint and paints a splash inside #root until React mounts. The update and worker-health banners use the warning tokens with a keyboard path on the clickable area, the update dismissal is version-scoped and survives reloads (dismissing 1.3.3 silences 1.3.3, not 1.3.4), boot/loading spinners use the primary token, and closing a report overlay clears the armed campaign selection so Delete selected can't point at rows scrolled out of view. Rebuilds are reproducible again: Tailwind v4's automatic source detection was scanning frontend/dist itself, so content hashes changed on every build (@source not "../dist" pins the scan surface).
